notes: Corrected: the supplied 'his' of 'at his best estate' moved from the participle's unit to אָדָם as a second realization of the written nominal (rule 25); 'at his best estate' is not a fixed formula the ASV never writes נִצָּב without, so rule 30's idiom-pronoun sentence does not reach it, and rule 25 forbids marking it added where a written nominal answers to it.
